sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION Our
net tangible book value on December 31, 2025, was approximately $15.58 million, or $3.83 per Class A Ordinary Share. Upon
our issuance of (i) 60,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares subsequent to December 31, 2025 and prior to September 28, 2026,
for approximately $14.51 million and (ii) 2,678,572 units in the September 2026 Registered Direct Offering, with each unit
consisting of one Class A Ordinary Share and one warrant, for approximately $3.0 million (without giving effect to any exercise of any
of such warrants), our adjusted net tangible book value on December 31, 2025 would have been approximately $30.09 million,
or $0.45 per Class A Ordinary Share. “Net tangible book value” is total assets minus the sum of liabilities and intangible
assets. “Net tangible book value per share” is net tangible book value divided by the total number of shares issued and outstanding. After
